All these uses of `proto_tree_add_expert_format` are incorrect and cause dissector bugs (#19333, #19334).

`proto_tree_add_expert_format` takes a proto_tree, not the item - it's intended for where the expert info isn't associated with a particular item, and creates a text-only item. To add an expert info to an item, call `expert_add_info_format()` instead, which will automatically cover the same set of bytes.
This is one of those things where the compiler should probably enforce that, but `proto_item` and `proto_tree` are typedef'd to the same `proto_node`.
@martin.r.mathieson a new check for your tools ? ;)
